fusions.name: Trail Picked Up
fusions.desc: A sting that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Whole Pack Roused
fusions.desc: A swarm pours out round you: it deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. If it hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Guarding the Threshold
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 9 seconds; every 1.2 seconds it deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Hive Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound fights beside you, striking an enemy within 4 tiles every 1.4 seconds. Each strike deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
